verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API exposes individual CRUD endpoints (e.g., POST/PATCH for vendors) and CSV import/export for accounting sync, which could be scripted to approximate bulk operations, but there is no documented batch/bulk endpoint or explicit multi-item operation support for AI agents. missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk API endpoints, documented multi-item transaction/approval operations, evidence of an agent performing bulk actions in practice.
